Source contracts: build/build

build/build

Shell · Tier B

Choose the compiled-distribution driver for the current host.

Usage

Invoke ./build/build with driver options; --help returns before build work.

Inputs

Host platform, --native-dev, forwarded arguments and SMTO_BUILD_PYTHON; otherwise prefer the repository virtual environment.

Side effects

Linux delegates to Docker orchestration unless native development was explicitly selected; other paths execute the Python build driver.

Cleanup

exec transfers signals and exit status to the selected driver, which owns build artifacts and temporary files.
